shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright rectangular slab
quadruped with head and legs in profile (fox/lion-like on A; small animal at lower right on B)
repeated small figures in a row
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing profile animal imagery organised in stacked zones, and each includes a small quadruped in profile, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows a purely animal/abstract repertoire (row of crouching creatures, a chevron/net band, a fox-like beast, a long-necked bird, insect-like and snake-like forms) with no humans, whereas B is dominated by two large, richly detailed anthropomorphic figures in profile with elaborate hair, beards, garments, and held attributes, rendered far more naturalistically and at a wholly different scale relative to the field.
